lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular maxima are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, forming a staggered vertical arrangement of three columns with roughly 4-5 nodes per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like pattern particularly prominent in the mid-lateral section behind the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal aspect and a shadowed gradient on the ventral aspect.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple curved, linear markings showing skin indentation or pigment variation are visible on the dorsal-lateral area immediately above the first three gill slits.
other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin displays a high-density clustering of small, uniform high-luminance spots that decrease in size toward the distal edge.
